name: Google Street View
description: Street View images for a box: the panoramas Google holds there, one image per panorama and heading, at the field of view, pitch and size you choose. Needs your own Google Maps API key with the Street View Static API enabled; Google bills its requests to you, and its terms allow storing only panorama IDs.
license: Google Street View: see the Google Maps Platform Terms

resources.name: Street View images
resources.description: One image per panorama and heading, each with the panorama's ID, place and capture month.

parameters.label: Area
parameters.description: The box to find panoramas in.

parameters.label: Spacing
parameters.description: How far apart the points asked for a panorama are.

parameters.label: Headings
parameters.description: One image per panorama for each heading chosen.

parameters.label: Pitch
parameters.description: Up or down from the horizon.

parameters.label: Most images
parameters.description: Panoramas are taken from across the box until there are this many images.
